review.access: Wizard spell; requires the campaign to permit this expanded source.
review.scope: Wizard-list access and displayed metadata checked. Full paid spell text was unavailable in this review; detailed stat blocks and unverified numerical claims are not reproduced.

references.title: Official Wizard spell list — access and displayed metadata

compendium.summary: A source-dependent utility option for a temporary skill-proficiency gap. Prefer party expertise and mundane preparation before spending a second-level slot.
warnings: Expanded-source permission is required; owning the book or seeing a spell in a builder is not campaign approval.
Tier is a situational Compendium assessment, not a letter grade quoted from Pack Tactics.
Full paid spell mechanics were not independently rechecked; consult the linked active entry before using detailed interactions.
tactics: Consider it before a consequential check that nobody already covers well; it is a copying or mission-preparation candidate, not an automatic combat pick.
It is on the Wizard list, but requires the campaign to allow its Strixhaven source. It does not grant another class's spell list or make an unknown spell learnable.

research.note: Prompted by the supplied Pack Tactics research package. Video timestamps are its attribution trail, not independently verified quotations; editorial advice is separated from official spell access.
